If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment swings from negative to positive over 3 days, shift forecast peak 2–3 days earlier and reduce peak value by 2–4%.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, suppress forecast overshoots by 1–3% in late horizon (25–30 days).  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, suppress forecast undershoots by 1–3% in early horizon (1–7 days).
